kth.description: static integer index about which to partition the array.

axis.description: static integer axis along which to partition the array; default is -1.

output.description: Indices which partition ``a`` at the ``kth`` value along ``axis``. The entries before ``kth`` are indices of values smaller than ``take(a, kth, axis)``, and entries after ``kth`` are indices of values larger than ``take(a, kth, axis)``
